text.faq_q_1: How do I choose the right appliance?
text.faq_a_1: Think about what you cook most often and how much counter space you have. Each product page lists the size, the settings and everything that comes in the box, so you can compare our appliances side by side and pick the one that suits your kitchen.
text.faq_q_2: How do I clean and care for my appliances?
text.faq_a_2: Unplug and let them cool, then wipe the body with a soft damp cloth. Removable parts such as jars and baskets can usually be washed in warm soapy water.
text.faq_q_3: Are the appliances safe to leave on the counter?
text.faq_a_3: Yes, when they are switched off and unplugged after use. Always follow the safety notes in the manual that comes with each product.
text.faq_q_4: How can I contact customer service?
text.faq_a_4: You can reach our team through the contact page. Tell us your order number if you have one and we will get back to you as soon as we can.
text.faq_q_5: Do you have a newsletter I can subscribe to?
